title: Filter Forensics
summary: Line-cited spec of filter_events_power_law.py: q=0.05 quantile regression, log10(volume)~log10(momentum_pct), keep rule is a volume floor conditional on momentum (not a momentum-extremity filter). Read-only refit matches momentum_events exactly (23,268/23,268, 100% overlap both directions). Traced the 5,911 NULL-date rows to a structural script gap (file2 has no 'date' column, only 'event_date'; the script's only schema reconciliation - volume->event_volume - doesn't cover it) - classification (b). Re-tested the 7,252 orphan folders and found 5,911 of them (81.5%) are the same date-bug artifact, not genuinely missing - true orphan count is 1,341, all consistent with ordinary filter rejects (0 sit above the boundary).

headline_metrics.value: medians close (44.41 vs 42.60) but NULL-date tail has a 53.8M outlier vs 48.6K max

decisions_log.decision: momentum_pct formula (T1c) determined empirically ((high-prev_close)/prev_close*100, corr 0.9997) rather than left undetermined
decisions_log.reason: the script never computes it and the generating scanner isn't in the repo; empirical match against file1 is strong enough to report as a finding, flagged as not code-confirmed

decisions_log.decision: T2 comparison key coalesces date with event_date: (ticker, COALESCE(date,event_date), momentum_pct 2dp)
decisions_log.reason: date is structurally NULL for all file2-sourced rows; a plain date-only key would silently exclude 25% of rows from the comparison

decisions_log.decision: orphan_classification.parquet and other results/phase_*/artifacts/*.parquet gitignored going forward
decisions_log.reason: Agent_Prompt_Standard.md v1.3 SS12 marks artifact parquets as regenerable, not source; phase_0c's already-tracked parquet is unaffected

surprises: 5,911 of the 7,252 'orphan' folders (81.5%) are not orphans - they are exactly the 5,911 NULL-date momentum_events rows, misclassified by 0c's date-based join. Re-joining on ticker+momentum+(date OR event_date) recovers them exactly.

0/409 parser-fix-recovered folders (dot-ticker/lowercase-suffix) have any rows in filtered_trades or filtered_quotes - confirmed genuine: the tables' entire 3,272-ticker universe contains zero dot or lowercase tickers.
market_cap_est and sector are declared momentum_events columns but are 100% NULL for every row in both date-status groups.
0c's own docs/ discovery (Agent_Prompt_Standard v1.2 copy, Strategy Program doc) predates this phase; the v1.3 promotion and canonical placement happened via Cooper's T0 instruction mid-phase.

output_files.artifacts: results/phase_1/artifacts/*.json (scan_input_inventory, refit_comparison, null_date_forensics, orphan_summary, ingestion_spotcheck) + orphan_classification.parquet (gitignored, regenerable)

blocking_items_for_next_phase: 1,341 genuine orphan folders exist on disk with trades/quotes data but no momentum_events row and no scan-input record explaining their absence beyond the q05 filter/invalid-volume split - not further characterized here.

409 parser-fix-recovered folders have zero DB coverage in filtered_trades/filtered_quotes - the folders and their parquet files exist on disk (per 0c) but were never ingested into the DuckDB tables; not remediated here (data/ is read-only, no ingestion performed).

The 5,911 false-orphan misclassification is a 0c artifact, not fixed at the source (0c's join_reconciliation_detail.json) - flagged here, not corrected in place, since that would be a Phase 0c file edit outside this phase's scope.
approval_gate: Do not begin Phase 2 or any follow-on work until Cooper has reviewed results and given explicit approval.
